title: nexus3.yaml
description: Per-repository nexus3 configuration file. Add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<path-to-repo-root>/docs/schema/nexus3.schema.json` as the first line of nexus3.yaml for editor autocomplete and validation.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1. A missing version field is a hard error.

allow.description: Additional hostnames the sandbox may reach. Merged (union) with --allow-host flags and the built-in perimeter allowlist; does not replace them.

policy.description: Destination-scoped path-policy entries. Each entry restricts what URL paths are reachable on a specific host. A path policy is required for any GitHub host that receives a secret (D-PDE-16).

items.description: Path-policy entry for one destination host. All listed paths use default-deny: only matching paths are allowed; all others are rejected.

paths.description: Positive path allowlist. Anchored globs; optional leading "METHOD " (e.g. "GET /repos/**" or "/repos/**" for any method). At least one entry required.

secrets.description: Host+credential bindings. Each entry attaches one env var (from the host environment) to one or more target hostnames. Security-critical: read from the trusted base ref only.

oneOf.description: Long form: {env, hosts}. Path policies belong in egress.policy, not here.

env.description: Name of the host env var whose value is injected as a credential.

hosts.description: Hostnames the credential is forwarded to.

sandbox.description: Per-repo sandbox defaults. Any field here is overridden by the corresponding CLI flag.

image.description: Container image name used when no --image flag is given.

memory.description: Sandbox RAM in MiB. 0 means use the built-in default.

vcpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs. 0 means use the built-in default.

mounts.description: List of host:guest mount entries, e.g. ".:/work". Relative host paths are resolved against the directory containing nexus3.yaml — not the process working directory. Superseded entirely by any --mount flag.

agent.description: Default agent profile name applied when no --agent flag is given (e.g. "claude-code"). Empty means no agent by default.

memory_max.description: RAM hotplug ceiling in MiB. 0 means use the built-in default (typically 4× boot memory or 4096 MiB, whichever is larger). Must exceed sandbox.memory when both are set. CLI --memory-max always wins over this config value.
